Agorapulse is a general-purpose social media scheduling and inbox management tool. Starting at $79/user/month on the annual plan, you get publishing, scheduling, a unified inbox, and reporting. But you still need to design every graphic, write every caption, edit every video, and produce all content yourself. There are no real estate templates, no local market content, and no industry-specific features. Per-user pricing means costs scale fast for teams.
